evidence.reason: The main writer names the artifact solely from `args.label or args.phase`, so a matrix boundary run with `--label` never writes the canonical `<case>.json` artifact. The downstream observe path resolves that canonical filename, so on a clean guest it fails and on a reused guest it can consume stale evidence. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the harness; the smallest fix is to also write the canonical matrix artifact or reject custom labels for phases with fixed downstream filenames.
